title: Biden’s Push to End the War in Gaza

sentences.zh: 好了，继续今天的节目。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In an unexpected speech last week,
sentences.zh: 在上周的一次意外演讲中，

sentences.en: President Biden revealed the details of a secret proposal intended to end the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统披露了一项旨在结束加沙战争的秘密提案的细节。

sentences.en: Most surprising was where that proposal had come from.
sentences.zh: 最令人惊讶的是该提案的来源。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Isabel Kirshner explains Biden's gambit and the difficult choice it presents for Israel's leader,
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事伊莎贝尔·克什纳将解释拜登的策略，以及它给以色列领导人带来的艰难抉择，

sentences.en: Benjamin Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月5日，星期三。

sentences.en: Isabel, tell us about this speech from President Biden last Friday at the White House.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，请给我们讲讲拜登总统上周五在白宫发表的这次演讲。

sentences.en: So last Friday, President Biden made a speech, and it came at a pivotal moment in the war because for weeks beforehand,
sentences.zh: 上周五，拜登总统发表了演讲，这正值战争的关键时刻，因为在此之前的几周里，

sentences.en: the whole world had been focused on Israel's long-delayed invasion of the city of Rafah, the southernmost city in the Gaza Strip,
sentences.zh: 全世界的目光都集中在以色列迟迟未动的拉法市入侵行动上，那是加沙地带最南端的城市，

sentences.en: and also the city that about a million displaced Palestinians had fled to, to find refuge from fighting in other areas of the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 也是约一百万流离失所的巴勒斯坦人逃往避难的地方，以躲避加沙地带其他地区的战火。

sentences.en: So understandably, there was huge concern internationally, and particularly a lot of pressure coming from the White House for Israel not to go into Rafah.
sentences.zh: 可以理解，国际社会对此深感担忧，白宫方面也施加了巨大压力，要求以色列不要进入拉法。

sentences.en: It was just considered way too risky.
sentences.zh: 这被认为风险太大了。

sentences.en: But for the Israelis, you know, they were saying the last battalions of Hamas are there, many hostages are there, and without taking control of that area,
sentences.zh: 但对以色列人来说，他们认为哈马斯的最后几个营就在那里，许多人质也在那里，如果不控制该地区，

sentences.en: the Israelis felt they wouldn't have accomplished anything.
sentences.zh: 以色列人觉得他们将一事无成。

sentences.en: So in the end, they did begin to move into the eastern part of Rafah.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，他们确实开始进入拉法东部。

sentences.en: But then, as the Israelis were operating in eastern Rafah with their tanks and ground troops, the Israelis on May the 26th carried out a strike, an airstrike.
sentences.zh: 但就在以色列人带着坦克和地面部队在拉法东部行动时，他们在5月26日发动了一次空袭。

sentences.en: This was an attack meant to target two Hamas operatives.
sentences.zh: 这次袭击旨在针对两名哈马斯武装人员。

sentences.en: And they did, in fact, strike those two operatives and killed them with what they said were the smallest missiles that their jets could carry.
sentences.zh: 他们确实击中了那两名武装人员，并用他们所说的战机能携带的最小导弹杀死了他们。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, that strike then set off an absolutely devastating fire, because where the area the strike took place in is right by a camp of makeshift shacks and tents
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，那次袭击随后引发了一场极其惨烈的火灾，因为袭击发生的区域就在一个临时窝棚和帐篷营地旁边，

sentences.en: where hundreds or thousands of Palestinians were sheltering.
sentences.zh: 那里有成百上千甚至上万名巴勒斯坦人在避难。

sentences.en: This fire ripped through the tents and ended up killing 45 civilians, according to the Gazan health authorities.
sentences.zh: 据加沙卫生部门称，这场大火席卷了帐篷，最终导致45名平民死亡。

sentences.en: And it was exactly the kind of disaster that everybody had feared if Israel were to operate in this crowded, southern, dusty border town.
sentences.zh: 这正是每个人都担心的灾难，如果以色列在这样一个拥挤、南部、尘土飞扬的边境城镇开展行动的话。

sentences.en: Which presumably put a lot more pressure on the Biden White House to do something about this war.
sentences.zh: 这大概给拜登白宫带来了更大的压力，要求他们对这场战争采取行动。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, we know that the White House, the Biden administration, would very much like to see this war come to an end as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，白宫，即拜登政府，非常希望看到这场战争尽快结束。

sentences.en: And then on Friday...
sentences.zh: 然后在周五……

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: Before I begin my remarks...
sentences.zh: 在开始我的讲话之前……

sentences.en: President Biden gives a speech.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统发表了演讲。

sentences.en: And surprisingly...
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是……

sentences.en: Now to another issue.
sentences.zh: 现在谈谈另一个问题。

sentences.en: This speech, when it turned to the Israel-Hamas war, was not about Rafa.
sentences.zh: 这次演讲在谈到以哈战争时，并没有提到拉法。

sentences.en: In fact, it was something totally different and much bigger.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是一个完全不同且更宏大的议题。

sentences.en: Israel has now offered, Israel has offered, a comprehensive new proposal.
sentences.zh: 以色列现在已经提出，以色列已经提出了一项全面的新提案。

sentences.en: It's a roadmap to an enduring ceasefire and the release of all hostages.
sentences.zh: 这是一份实现持久停火和释放所有人质的路线图。

sentences.en: What President Biden described as the outline of an Israeli proposal for a ceasefire, truce, and hostage release deal with Hamas that would end the war.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统所描述的是一份以色列提出的停火、休战和与哈马斯交换人质协议的纲要，旨在结束战争。

sentences.en: This proposal has been transmitted by Qatar to Hamas.
sentences.zh: 该提案已由卡塔尔转交给哈马斯。

sentences.en: Today, I want to lay out its terms for the American citizens and for the world.
sentences.zh: 今天，我想向美国公民和全世界阐述其条款。

sentences.en: And Isabel, what did he mean exactly by the Israeli proposal?
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，他所说的“以色列提案”到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, there's been a lot of smoke and mirrors around this whole process of talks and negotiations between Israel and Hamas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在以色列和哈马斯之间这一整套谈判过程中，存在着很多虚假信息和烟雾弹。

sentences.en: And in fact, the last time we saw a negotiation actually result in a temporary ceasefire and a partial hostage release was at the end of last November.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们上一次看到谈判真正达成临时停火和部分人质释放是在去年11月底。

sentences.en: But in fact, there had been this on-again, off-again attempt at getting negotiations back on track over the last few weeks.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，在过去几周里，一直有断断续续的尝试试图让谈判重回正轨。

sentences.en: And it soon came to light that this was the latest Israeli proposal that was apparently presented.
sentences.zh: 很快人们发现，这就是最近提出的以色列提案。

sentences.en: And this proposal, it turns out, was unanimously approved as a basis for the negotiation by Israel's war cabinet.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，该提案已由以色列战时内阁一致批准作为谈判基础。

sentences.en: And here's an American president spelling out this previously undisclosed Israeli position on television.
sentences.zh: 而现在，一位美国总统正在电视上阐述这一此前未公开的以色列立场。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the Israeli public knew nothing about this.
sentences.zh: 而且以色列公众对此一无所知。

sentences.en: So what does Biden actually say?
sentences.zh: 那么拜登到底说了什么？

sentences.en: What does he say is in this proposal?
sentences.zh: 他说这个提案里有什么？

sentences.en: OK, well, what he says...
sentences.zh: 好的，他说……

sentences.en: This new proposal has three phases.
sentences.zh: 这个新提案分为三个阶段。

sentences.en: Three.
sentences.zh: 三个阶段。

sentences.en: He presents it as a deal in three phases, which is generally in line with all the previous plans of the last few months.
sentences.zh: 他将其呈现为一份三阶段协议，这与过去几个月的所有先前计划基本一致。

sentences.en: And the first phase would involve a six-week temporary ceasefire, during which a certain number of hostages...
sentences.zh: 第一阶段将包括为期六周的临时停火，在此期间，一定数量的人质……

sentences.en: Including women, the elderly, the wounded...
sentences.zh: 包括妇女、老人、伤员……

sentences.en: The most vulnerable ones...
sentences.zh: 最脆弱的人群……

sentences.en: There are American hostages who would be released at this stage, and we want them home.
sentences.zh: 还有美国人质，他们将在这一阶段获释，我们希望他们回家。

sentences.en: ...would be exchanged for hundreds of Palestinian prisoners in Israeli jails.
sentences.zh: ……将与以色列监狱中的数百名巴勒斯坦囚犯进行交换。

sentences.en: And Israeli forces would be withdrawing from population centers within the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 以色列军队将从加沙地带的人口中心撤出。

sentences.en: With 600 trucks carrying aid into Gaza every single day.
sentences.zh: 每天有600辆卡车运送援助物资进入加沙。

sentences.en: Humanitarian aid would be flowing at a much greater level, and generally the beginning of a change in atmosphere and climate.
sentences.zh: 人道主义援助将以更大的规模流动，总体上开始改变氛围和环境。

sentences.en: So this seems in some ways like the temporary ceasefire in November, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这在某些方面看起来就像11月的临时停火，对吧？

sentences.en: Women and children, vulnerable hostages, a cease in hostilities for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 妇女和儿童，脆弱的人质，为期六周的敌对行动停止。

sentences.en: What about phase two?
sentences.zh: 第二阶段呢？

sentences.en: Well, here we get to the crucial part, because during phase one, the sides are supposed to start negotiating phase two.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这里到了关键部分，因为在第一阶段，双方应该开始谈判第二阶段。

sentences.en: Now, I'll be straight with you.
sentences.zh: 说实话。

sentences.en: There are a number of details to negotiate to move from phase one to phase two.
sentences.zh: 从第一阶段过渡到第二阶段还有许多细节需要谈判。

sentences.en: And phase two is supposed to culminate in all remaining living hostages released and exchanged again for many more Palestinian prisoners from Israeli jails.
sentences.zh: 第二阶段应该以释放所有剩余的在世人质并再次与以色列监狱中更多的巴勒斯坦囚犯进行交换而告终。

sentences.en: This would involve also the withdrawal of Israeli troops from the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 这也将涉及以色列军队从加沙地带撤出。

sentences.en: And in his speech, President Biden does say that as long as Hamas lives up to its commitments, the temporary ceasefire would become, in the words of the Israeli proposal,
sentences.zh: 拜登总统在演讲中确实表示，只要哈马斯履行承诺，临时停火就会按照以色列提案的措辞，

sentences.en: the cessation of hostilities permanently, essentially meaning the end of the war.
sentences.zh: 变成永久性的敌对行动停止，本质上意味着战争结束。

sentences.en: So Biden is actually talking about the end of the war, like he's saying that out loud, which is not something we've been hearing from Israel at all, at least publicly.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登实际上是在谈论战争的结束，他公开说了出来，这并不是我们从以色列那里听到的，至少在公开场合是这样。

sentences.en: On the contrary, in fact, our colleagues wrote a story at the end of last week when one senior
sentences.zh: 相反，事实上，我们的同事在上周末写了一篇报道，当时一位高级

sentences.en: Israeli official said the war would last until at least the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 以色列官员称战争至少会持续到年底。

sentences.en: So this is something very new.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常新的说法。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then we get to phase three, because there's a third phase to this plan.
sentences.zh: 然后我们进入第三阶段，因为这个计划还有第三阶段。

sentences.en: And that is moving ahead already to the day after the war, which has been kept very vague by the Israelis up to now.
sentences.zh: 那就是已经推进到战后时期，而这一点以色列人至今一直含糊其辞。

sentences.en: And the phase that President Biden outlined was essentially just for a major reconstruction plan for Gaza.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统概述的阶段本质上只是加沙的一项重大重建计划。

sentences.en: That's the offer that's now on the table and what we've been asking for.
sentences.zh: 这就是现在摆在桌面上的提议，也是我们一直要求的。

sentences.en: It's what we need.
sentences.zh: 这是我们所需要的。

sentences.en: So the president is saying that this is a deal that should be accepted, that meets the requirements of both sides, that can point to a path forward.
sentences.zh: 所以总统是在说，这是一份应该被接受的协议，它满足了双方的要求，可以指明前进的道路。

sentences.en: And he makes a couple of points to bolster that.
sentences.zh: 他提出了几点来支持这一观点。

sentences.en: The people of Israel should know they can make this offer without any further risk to their own security because they've devastated Hamas' forces.
sentences.zh: 以色列人民应该知道，他们可以在不给自身安全带来进一步风险的情况下提出这一提议，因为他们已经摧毁了哈马斯的武装力量。

sentences.en: One of which is that, in his view, Hamas has already been sufficiently degraded and devastated to the point where, as President Biden puts it,
sentences.zh: 其中一点是，在他看来，哈马斯已经被充分削弱和摧毁，以至于正如拜登总统所言，

sentences.en: Hamas is no longer capable of carrying out another October the 7th.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯已不再有能力发动另一次10月7日那样的袭击。

sentences.en: In other words, that goal of, you know, total victory that Netanyahu talks about,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，内塔尼亚胡所谈论的那个“彻底胜利”的目标，

sentences.en: Biden is actually saying they've accomplished it.
sentences.zh: 拜登实际上是在说他们已经实现了。

sentences.en: The Israelis have accomplished it.
sentences.zh: 以色列人已经实现了。

sentences.en: Not really, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实并没有。

sentences.en: He takes on Netanyahu on the total victory slogan.
sentences.zh: 他针对内塔尼亚胡的“彻底胜利”口号提出了挑战。

sentences.en: Indefinite war in pursuit of an unidentified notion of total victory will not bring Israel, will not bring down, bogged down, will only bog down Israel and Gaza.
sentences.zh: 为了追求一个不明晰的“彻底胜利”概念而进行无限期战争，不会给以色列带来好处，只会让以色列陷入泥潭，让加沙陷入泥潭。

sentences.en: Draining the economic, military, and human resources.
sentences.zh: 消耗经济、军事和人力资源。

sentences.en: And furthering Israel's isolation in the world.
sentences.zh: 并加剧以色列在世界上的孤立。

sentences.en: And says that total victory is a kind of nebulous and unrealistic goal that would basically mean indefinite war.
sentences.zh: 并称“彻底胜利”是一种模糊且不切实际的目标，基本上意味着无限期战争。

sentences.en: Because what does total victory mean?
sentences.zh: 因为“彻底胜利”意味着什么？

sentences.en: You can't kill every last Hamas operative.
sentences.zh: 你不可能杀光每一个哈马斯武装人员。

sentences.en: And even if you did, presumably there would be many more Palestinians who would come to replace them.
sentences.zh: 即使你做到了，想必也会有更多的巴勒斯坦人来取代他们。

sentences.en: And in a way, he's using this speech to go over the head of Netanyahu and go straight to the Israeli people and present them with these terms to, in a way, corner Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他利用这次演讲越过内塔尼亚胡，直接向以色列人民喊话，向他们提出这些条款，在某种程度上是为了逼迫内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: But also to put down the gauntlet to Hamas and say, here are the terMs.
sentences.zh: 但也是为了向哈马斯下战书，说：这就是条款。

sentences.en: They sound very like the terms Hamas was asking for.
sentences.zh: 它们听起来非常像哈马斯所要求的条款。

sentences.en: And putting Hamas equally on the spot to come back to the table, even though Israel is still fighting Imrafah.
sentences.zh: 这也让哈马斯同样处于被动地位，不得不回到谈判桌前，尽管以色列仍在拉法进行战斗。

sentences.en: It's time to begin this new stage.
sentences.zh: 是时候开启这个新阶段了。

sentences.en: For the hostages to come home.
sentences.zh: 让人质回家。

sentences.en: For Israel to be secure.
sentences.zh: 让以色列获得安全。

sentences.en: For the suffering to stop.
sentences.zh: 让苦难停止。

sentences.en: It's time for this war to end.
sentences.zh: 是时候结束这场战争了。

sentences.en: For the day after to begin.
sentences.zh: 是时候开启战后时期了。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: So Biden is essentially saying here, listen, Israel, you have won the war effectively.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登在这里本质上是在说：听着，以色列，你实际上已经赢得了战争。

sentences.en: Like Hamas is degraded.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯已经被削弱了。

sentences.en: Now it's time to accept the ceasefire deal that you yourself have designed.
sentences.zh: 现在是时候接受你自己设计的停火协议了。

sentences.en: What was the reaction inside Israel?
sentences.zh: 以色列国内有什么反应？

sentences.en: The initial reaction took a while to come because President Biden made his speech and it landed at about 8.30 in the evening on Friday, Israel time.
sentences.zh: 最初的反应花了一些时间才出现，因为拜登总统发表讲话时，以色列时间是周五晚上8点半左右。

sentences.en: And this is the time where many, many families are sitting around their Sabbath dinner table, as I was with my family and friends.
sentences.zh: 那是许多家庭围坐在安息日晚餐桌旁的时间，就像我和我的家人朋友一样。

sentences.en: Not watching the news, not watching the news, not looking at phones for the most part.
sentences.zh: 大家没有看新闻，没有看新闻，大部分时间也没有看手机。

sentences.en: Observant Jews have actually switched off for the Sabbath and aren't going to hear any news until Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 虔诚的犹太人实际上已经为了安息日关掉了设备，直到周六晚上才会听到任何新闻。

sentences.en: And as the news did begin to trickle out, it really shook Israel up.
sentences.zh: 当新闻开始传出时，它确实震撼了以色列。

sentences.en: And this leaves Netanyahu in a great bind because for months he's really been playing for time and juggling competing interests and really not having to make a decision one way or the other on what comes next.
sentences.zh: 这让内塔尼亚胡陷入了巨大的困境，因为几个月来他一直在拖延时间，在相互竞争的利益之间周旋，实际上并没有对下一步该怎么做做出任何决定。

sentences.en: We've been hearing that Rafat is really the last stronghold of Hamas and this is something the military has to do.
sentences.zh: 我们一直听说拉法确实是哈马斯的最后一个据点，这是军方必须要做的事情。

sentences.en: But after that, there was just a kind of void and no news on the hostages or a ceasefire or a deal on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 但在此之后，就只剩下一种真空状态，关于人质、停火或协议的消息遥遥无期。

sentences.en: And so when this speech was made, suddenly it shook up everything.
sentences.zh: 所以当这次演讲发表时，它突然震撼了一切。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu is suddenly facing a very crucial choice.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡突然面临一个非常关键的选择。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是维娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games，立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So Isabel, you said that this is a very important moment for Netanyahu, that now he really is facing a choice.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，你说这对内塔尼亚胡来说是一个非常重要的时刻，他现在真的面临着一个选择。

sentences.en: What does he do?
sentences.zh: 他会怎么做？

sentences.en: What does he come out and say?
sentences.zh: 他会出来说些什么？

sentences.en: So his office actually put out a statement and his first response was that Israel is sticking to its objectives of the destruction of Hamas's military and governing capabilities.
sentences.zh: 他的办公室确实发表了一份声明，他的初步回应是，以色列坚持其摧毁哈马斯军事和治理能力的目标。

sentences.en: And he said the actual proposal put forward by Israel would allow Israel to uphold these principles.
sentences.zh: 他还表示，以色列提出的实际方案将使以色列能够坚持这些原则。

sentences.en: Now, this was a slightly ambiguous response that you could pass in different ways.
sentences.zh: 这是一个略显模糊的回应，你可以有不同的解读。

sentences.en: He wasn't exactly denying that this was an Israeli proposal.
sentences.zh: 他并没有明确否认这就是以色列的提议。

sentences.en: And indeed, we quickly learned that, in fact, Israel's war cabinet had unanimously voted on the general outlines of what President Biden had presented.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们很快得知，以色列战时内阁确实一致投票通过了拜登总统所提出方案的大致框架。

sentences.en: He wasn't denying it.
sentences.zh: 他没有否认这一点。

sentences.en: But the one thing missing from that statement was this declaration we'd been hearing for months on end that the war wouldn't end until there was total victory.
sentences.zh: 但那份声明中缺少了一样东西，就是我们几个月来一直听到的那句声明：在取得彻底胜利之前，战争不会结束。

sentences.en: That had gone.
sentences.zh: 那句话不见了。

sentences.en: So total victory had gone, which is a difference, which means potentially the war goals have shifted a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以“彻底胜利”的说法消失了，这是一种变化，意味着战争目标可能已经发生了一些转变。

sentences.en: Well, the way he articulated it is talking about the degradation or dismantling of Hamas's capabilities, as opposed to talking about the total elimination of Hamas as a movement.
sentences.zh: 他表达的方式是谈论削弱或瓦解哈马斯的能力，而不是谈论彻底消灭哈马斯这个组织。

sentences.en: And then he followed up.
sentences.zh: 随后他又跟进了一步。

sentences.en: His office put out another statement on Saturday, also still during the Sabbath, which was a little stronger.
sentences.zh: 他的办公室在周六，也就是安息日期间，又发表了一份声明，语气稍微强硬了一些。

sentences.en: He said under the proposal, Israel would insist on its conditions being met, these same war objectives, before a permanent ceasefire is put in place,
sentences.zh: 他说，根据该提议，以色列将坚持要求满足其条件，即同样的战争目标，然后才会实施永久停火，

sentences.en: and that any suggestion that Israel would agree to that permanent ceasefire before the conditions are met would be a non-starter.
sentences.zh: 并表示任何关于以色列会在条件满足前同意永久停火的建议都是不可接受的。

sentences.en: But again, you know, it was kind of conditional and could be interpreted in different ways.
sentences.zh: 但同样，你知道，这还是带有条件的，可以有不同的解读。

sentences.en: At what point does one declare that the capabilities have been dismantled or sufficiently degraded?
sentences.zh: 在什么节点上才能宣布这些能力已被瓦解或充分削弱？

sentences.en: So it left a lot of room for maneuver.
sentences.zh: 所以这留下了很大的回旋余地。

sentences.en: And so what is Netanyahu up to here, Isabel?
sentences.zh: 那么内塔尼亚胡在这里到底想干什么，伊莎贝尔？

sentences.en: I think he's trying to balance all these competing sides.
sentences.zh: 我认为他正试图平衡所有这些相互冲突的立场。

sentences.en: He seems to be trying not to torpedo the chances of this deal, but at the same time to be able to hang on politically
sentences.zh: 他似乎既不想破坏达成协议的机会，同时又想在政治上保住自己的位置，

sentences.en: when he has a very serious challenge looming within his government, should this deal go ahead.
sentences.zh: 因为如果协议推进，他的政府内部将面临非常严峻的挑战。

sentences.en: So tell me about that challenge.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说那个挑战。

sentences.en: Israel's government is formed of a coalition of parties.
sentences.zh: 以色列政府是由多个政党组成的联合政府。

sentences.en: Netanyahu's Likud is the main party.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的利库德集团是主要政党。

sentences.en: But it totally relies for its majority in parliament on its partners in the coalition.
sentences.zh: 但它在议会中的多数席位完全依赖于联合政府中的伙伴。

sentences.en: And they include two ultra-Orthodox parties and two far-right parties.
sentences.zh: 其中包括两个极右翼政党和两个极端正统派政党。

sentences.en: And the far-right parties have both come out explicitly saying that should this deal, as outlined by President Biden, go ahead, they will not be party to it.
sentences.zh: 两个极右翼政党都明确表示，如果拜登总统概述的这项协议得以推进，他们将不会参与其中。

sentences.en: So Netanyahu faces this real political danger on his right.
sentences.zh: 所以内塔尼亚胡在右翼面临着真正的政治危险。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So there are the leaders of these two right-wing parties who he relies on for his coalition government.
sentences.zh: 他所依赖的联合政府中，那两个右翼政党的领导人就是如此。

sentences.en: He relies on them for his majority in parliament.
sentences.zh: 他在议会中的多数席位依赖于他们。

sentences.en: And the leaders of those parties are Itamar Benkvir, who's the national security minister, and Bezalel Smotrich, who is currently the finance minister.
sentences.zh: 这些政党的领导人分别是现任国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔，以及现任财政部长比撒列·斯莫特里赫。

sentences.en: Now, neither of these parties nor their leaders are sitting in the much more tight and small war cabinet
sentences.zh: 这两个政党及其领导人并不在那个规模更小、更紧密的战时内阁中，

sentences.en: that actually oversees and directs and makes the decisions on the course of the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 而正是那个内阁在监督、指导并决定加沙战争的进程。

sentences.en: They were seen as way too extreme to be part of that forum.
sentences.zh: 他们被认为太极端了，无法进入那个决策圈。

sentences.en: That forum is much more reflective of the national consensus.
sentences.zh: 那个决策圈更能反映全国共识。

sentences.en: But these parties are part of the broader government.
sentences.zh: 但这些政党是更广泛政府的一部分。

sentences.en: And they have threatened not only to oppose the deal, as outlined by President Biden, should it go ahead, but they have actually vowed if it does go ahead,
sentences.zh: 他们不仅威胁说如果拜登总统概述的协议得以推进，他们将予以反对，而且他们实际上发誓，如果协议真的推进，

sentences.en: they would withdraw their support to Netanyahu and bring his government down.
sentences.zh: 他们将撤回对内塔尼亚胡的支持，并推翻他的政府。

sentences.en: And if his government were to collapse as a result, he would then be facing a new election.
sentences.zh: 如果他的政府因此垮台，他将面临新的选举。

sentences.en: Now, he has been trying to stave off the end of the war and the prospect of new elections ever since October the 7th,
sentences.zh: 自10月7日以来，他一直试图推迟战争的结束和新选举的前景，

sentences.en: because then he's in danger of facing that public reckoning for the perceived failures,
sentences.zh: 因为那样他就有可能面临公众对所谓失败的清算，

sentences.en: the government's policy failures, the military's failures, the intelligence failures leading up to the Hamas-led attack of October the 7th.
sentences.zh: 包括政府的政策失败、军事失败以及导致10月7日哈马斯领导的袭击的情报失败。

sentences.en: But we really might be getting to crunch time when it comes to his political lifeline here.
sentences.zh: 但当涉及到他的政治生命线时，我们可能真的到了关键时刻。

sentences.en: So this is a pretty dramatic moment for Netanyahu then, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这对内塔尼亚胡来说是一个非常戏剧性的时刻，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, he's under tremendous pressure from Biden, his biggest ally.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他正承受着来自他最大的盟友拜登的巨大压力。

sentences.en: Biden's basically asking him to choose between this deal, which means the end of the war, something his coalition partners, these hard right guys, really don't want,
sentences.zh: 拜登基本上是在要求他在接受这项意味着战争结束的协议（他的联合政府伙伴，那些极右翼分子，非常不希望看到这一点），

sentences.en: and his own power, essentially, right?
sentences.zh: 和保住自己的权力之间做出选择，对吧？

sentences.en: Staying alive politically or the end of the war and the hostages coming home.
sentences.zh: 是政治上保住地位，还是结束战争并让所有人质回家。

sentences.en: That is a very stark choice.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常严峻的选择。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And then there are other choices that he has to weigh because, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且他还有其他需要权衡的选择，因为你知道，

sentences.en: Israel has been increasingly isolated and under international censure for its prosecution of the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 以色列因其在加沙的战争行为而日益孤立，并受到国际社会的谴责。

sentences.en: Netanyahu himself is facing the prospect of possible arrest warrants being put out against him from the International Criminal Court in The Hague.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡本人正面临海牙国际刑事法院可能对他发出逮捕令的前景。

sentences.en: Israel is in the dock on a genocide case in the International Court of Justice in The Hague.
sentences.zh: 以色列正在海牙国际法院就种族灭绝案受审。

sentences.en: So should he go ahead with this deal, he has been offered sweeteners like an invitation to address Congress.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他推进这项协议，他会得到一些甜头，比如受邀在国会发表演讲。

sentences.en: And this would, in a way, be a way of bringing him back into the fold.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上将是一种让他重回主流的方式。

sentences.en: So, Isabel, say Netanyahu approves this proposal.
sentences.zh: 那么，伊莎贝尔，假设内塔尼亚胡批准了这个提议。

sentences.en: How likely is it that the right wing, you know, Smotrich and Ben-Gavir, actually do leave the government?
sentences.zh: 右翼，也就是斯莫特里赫和本-格维尔，真的离开政府的可能性有多大？

sentences.en: I mean, they would be giving up power too, no?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们也会失去权力，不是吗？

sentences.en: They would.
sentences.zh: 确实会。

sentences.en: And if we look at all the opinion polls being done in Israel in the last few months,
sentences.zh: 如果我们看看过去几个月在以色列进行的所有民意调查，

sentences.en: but Salel Smotrich and his Religious Zionism Party, for one, would barely scrape back into Parliament in another election.
sentences.zh: 斯莫特里赫和他的宗教犹太复国主义党，在下一次选举中几乎无法保住议会席位。

sentences.en: And therefore, there's a lot at stake for him too.
sentences.zh: 因此，对他来说，风险也很大。

sentences.en: And for Itamar Ben-Gavir, because if the next government that's formed is not going to be a right wing and far right government, he would find himself out of power too.
sentences.zh: 对于伊塔马尔·本-格维尔也是如此，因为如果下一届政府不是右翼和极右翼政府，他也会发现自己失去了权力。

sentences.en: But Isabel, let's say they do leave.
sentences.zh: 但伊莎贝尔，假设他们真的离开了。

sentences.en: What happens in that scenario?
sentences.zh: 那种情况下会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, the assumption is that the government would collapse, it would lose its majority.
sentences.zh: 嗯，普遍的假设是政府会垮台，失去多数席位。

sentences.en: And naturally, the Knesset would vote to dissolve itself and set a date for a new election, which would have to come within five months.
sentences.zh: 自然地，议会会投票解散并设定新的选举日期，必须在五个月内举行。

sentences.en: And during that period, this government would turn into a caretaker government.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，本届政府将转变为看守政府。

sentences.en: Now, usually a caretaker government that's a transitional one in that period before elections isn't supposed to make dramatic decisions for the country.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，选举前的过渡性看守政府不应该为国家做出重大决定。

sentences.en: But, you know, being a caretaker government during wartime, this puts Israel in uncharted political territory.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，在战时成为看守政府，这让以色列处于未知的政治领域。

sentences.en: Then theoretically, if we were to ask, could such a government even approve a deal once it had been negotiated, even without the support of those far right parties,
sentences.zh: 那么理论上，如果我们问，这样的政府在谈判达成后，即使没有那些极右翼政党的支持，是否还能批准协议，

sentences.en: because apparently there would still be enough in favor to see it through.
sentences.zh: 因为显然仍然有足够的支持者来推动它通过。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So it seems like there are a lot of possibilities for how this could go, but it does, in a way, rely on Netanyahu deciding what Israel's course will be.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来事情的发展有很多可能性，但在某种程度上，这取决于内塔尼亚胡决定以色列的走向。

sentences.en: And it seems like he probably needs to land on one of these options.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来他可能需要在这几个选项中做出决定。

sentences.en: What do you think he's going to do?
sentences.zh: 你认为他会怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, it might not end up being black and white, take the deal or not take the deal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，结果可能并非非黑即白，即接受协议或不接受协议。

sentences.en: We might end up seeing something in between, because, you know, I think Netanyahu, who is facing huge public pressure to bring back those hostages who still are alive,
sentences.zh: 我们最终可能会看到介于两者之间的情况，因为，你知道，我认为内塔尼亚胡正面临巨大的公众压力，要求带回那些仍然活着的人质，

sentences.en: would definitely want to move ahead with at least that first part of the deal that would see a six-week temporary ceasefire in return for the most vulnerable hostages.
sentences.zh: 他肯定会希望至少推进协议的第一部分，即以释放最脆弱的人质为代价，换取六周的临时停火。

sentences.en: And then you get into the much trickier part of that negotiation for the next stage, which would involve essentially ending the war.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会进入下一阶段谈判中更棘手的部分，这本质上涉及结束战争。

sentences.en: And it could be that, you know, we might see Netanyahu wanting to proceed with this deal, but only partially, and then get to a point where it can't go further.
sentences.zh: 可能的情况是，我们可能会看到内塔尼亚胡想要推进这项协议，但只是部分推进，然后到达一个无法再进一步的地步。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu is probably very keenly aware of the American political timetable.
sentences.zh: 而且内塔尼亚胡可能非常敏锐地意识到了美国的政治时间表。

sentences.en: There are skeptics here who say that by Labor Day, all the American attention is going to be focused on America's own internal politics running up to the November elections,
sentences.zh: 这里有一些怀疑论者说，到劳动节时，美国所有的注意力都将集中在美国国内政治上，为11月的选举做准备，

sentences.en: and that Netanyahu basically just has to survive another 90 days to get to that point, at which point the pressure subsides.
sentences.zh: 而内塔尼亚胡基本上只需要再撑过90天就能达到那个节点，届时压力就会减小。

sentences.en: So this is a scenario in which he just basically runs out the clock.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个他基本上是在拖延时间的剧本。

sentences.en: He keeps on that tightrope.
sentences.zh: 他继续走在那根钢丝上。

sentences.en: That's a possibility, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 那绝对是一种可能性。

sentences.en: And one that he would be very adept at doing if the past is anything to go by.
sentences.zh: 如果以过去的情况来看，他非常擅长这样做。

sentences.en: Okay, so there are a number of ways Netanyahu could actually handle this.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以内塔尼亚胡确实有多种处理方式。

sentences.en: How should we think about what Biden has really accomplished here?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何看待拜登在这里真正取得的成就？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's hard to say that one speech is going to change the course or the outcome of this war,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为很难说一次演讲就能改变这场战争的进程或结果，

sentences.en: but it certainly has crystallized the issues and brought them out into the light
sentences.zh: 但它无疑使问题变得清晰，并将它们带到了聚光灯下，

sentences.en: after months and months of murkiness that Netanyahu was able to, in a way, hide behind and operate within.
sentences.zh: 在经历了数月之久的模糊不清之后，内塔尼亚胡曾能够以某种方式躲在其中并进行操作。

sentences.en: And I think now he's in the spotlight and assuming that Hamas is willing to accept and go along with this negotiation for this proposal.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在他处于聚光灯下，假设哈马斯愿意接受并配合这项提议的谈判，

sentences.en: The Israeli public's expectations have certainly been risen now toward a deal.
sentences.zh: 以色列公众对达成协议的期望现在肯定已经提高了。

sentences.en: And all eyes are now on Netanyahu to see which way he will go.
sentences.zh: 现在所有的目光都集中在内塔尼亚胡身上，看他会选择哪条路。

sentences.en: Isabel, thank you.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: In an interview with Time magazine published on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 在周二发表的《时代》杂志采访中，

sentences.en: Biden was asked whether Netanyahu was prolonging the war in Gaza in an effort to hold on to office.
sentences.zh: 拜登被问及内塔尼亚胡是否为了保住职位而延长加沙战争。

sentences.en: Biden said, quote,
sentences.zh: 拜登说，引用如下：

sentences.en: There is every reason for people to draw that conclusion.
sentences.zh: 人们有充分的理由得出这个结论。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Republican lawmakers in Arizona voted to put a ballot measure before voters in November that would make unlawfully crossing the border from Mexico a crime in the state.
sentences.zh: 周二，亚利桑那州的共和党议员投票决定在11月将一项投票提案提交给选民，该提案将把从墨西哥非法越境定为该州的犯罪行为。

sentences.en: The move would put the border crisis directly onto the ballot in a key swing state, potentially firing up anti-immigration conservative voters.
sentences.zh: 此举将把边境危机直接推向关键摇摆州的选票，可能会激发反移民的保守派选民。

sentences.en: It is similar to a law passed in Texas earlier this year, currently held up in court after it was challenged by the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 这类似于德克萨斯州今年早些时候通过的一项法律，该法律在受到拜登政府质疑后目前被法院搁置。

sentences.en: And the results of a major election in India have been tallied, and they are deeply disappointing for India's prime minister, Narendra Modi.
sentences.zh: 印度一场重大选举的结果已经出炉，这对印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪来说是非常令人失望的。

sentences.en: Modi appeared to have secured a third consecutive term in office.
sentences.zh: 莫迪似乎已经确保了连续第三个任期。

sentences.en: However, his BJP party did not deliver the landslide victory it had promised, and even lost its majority in parliament.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的印度人民党（BJP）并没有实现其承诺的压倒性胜利，甚至失去了在议会的多数席位。

sentences.en: Now Modi and the BJP must come to an agreement with other parties in order to form a coalition government in India's parliamentary system.
sentences.zh: 现在莫迪和印度人民党必须与其他政党达成协议，以便在印度的议会制体系中组建联合政府。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Will Reed, Eric Kropke, and Sidney Harper.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由威尔·里德、埃里克·克罗普克和西德尼·哈珀制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Brendan Klingenberg and Michael Benoit.
sentences.zh: 由布伦丹·克林根伯格和迈克尔·贝努瓦编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marianne Lozano, Diane Wong, Dan Powell, and Rowan Mimisto, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛萨诺、黛安·黄、丹·鲍威尔和罗文·米米斯托的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能睡觉的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会因为喝醉而睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
